step: Record runner clients and select pinned PG16 service clients
command:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p /tmp/p8-rollback-evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/p8-pg16-bin"
for tool in pg_dump pg_restore psql; do
  if command -v "$tool" >/dev/null; then
    "$tool" --version
  else
    echo "runner $tool: not installed"
  fi
  ln -s "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/scripts/p8_pg16_client.sh" "$RUNNER_TEMP/p8-pg16-bin/$tool"
  version="$(docker exec "$P8_PG_CONTAINER" "$tool" --version)"
  echo "matched $version"
  [[ "$version" =~ PostgreSQL\)\ 16\. ]]
done | tee /tmp/p8-rollback-evidence/client-versions.txt
docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' "$P8_PG_CONTAINER" | tee /tmp/p8-rollback-evidence/server-image.txt
docker exec "$P8_PG_CONTAINER" psql -U postgres -d p8_rehearsal -Atc 'SHOW server_version; SHOW server_version_num;' | tee /tmp/p8-rollback-evidence/server-versions.txt
major="$(docker exec "$P8_PG_CONTAINER" psql -U postgres -d p8_rehearsal -Atc 'SHOW server_version_num')"
test "$((major / 10000))" -eq 16
echo "P8_PG_CONTAINER=$P8_PG_CONTAINER" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/p8-pg16-bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

step: Reproduce incompatible PG17 restore against the same PG16 fixture
command:
set -euo pipefail
for tool in pg_dump pg_restore psql; do
  docker run --rm "$P8_INCOMPATIBLE_CLIENT" "$tool" --version
done | tee /tmp/p8-rollback-evidence/incompatible-client-versions.txt
psql postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c 'CREATE DATABASE p8_incompatible_verify'
docker run --rm --network host "$P8_INCOMPATIBLE_CLIENT" pg_dump --format=custom --no-owner --no-acl --dbname=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/p8_rehearsal > /tmp/p8-rollback-evidence/incompatible.dump
if docker run --rm -i --network host "$P8_INCOMPATIBLE_CLIENT" pg_restore --exit-on-error --no-owner --no-acl --dbname=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/p8_incompatible_verify < /tmp/p8-rollback-evidence/incompatible.dump > /tmp/p8-rollback-evidence/incompatible-restore.log 2>&1; then
  echo 'Incompatible restore unexpectedly succeeded' >&2
  exit 1
else
  code=$?
  echo "$code" > /tmp/p8-rollback-evidence/incompatible-exit.txt
  test "$code" -eq 1
  grep -F 'unrecognized configuration parameter "transaction_timeout"' /tmp/p8-rollback-evidence/incompatible-restore.log
  grep -F 'SET transaction_timeout = 0;' /tmp/p8-rollback-evidence/incompatible-restore.log
fi
